title: snack setup claude payload
description: The `data` of a `snack setup claude --json` document. Claude Code is read from its own JSONL histories, so there is no plugin to register. Frozen at 0.9: a field here does not disappear or change meaning without a major release, and a consumer must tolerate fields added by a later minor.

source.description: The capacity source as it was written to configuration. Identifiers only -- never the path of a project or the title of a session.

fingerprint.description: The client schema family setup recognized, and whether SNACK supports it. An unsupported family is refused rather than guessed at.

dry_run.description: What a dry run observed, and what a real run applied.

recovered_setup_journal.description: Present when setup completed an interrupted earlier run before doing its own work.
